title: HHS-04-R2: GAO-24-106276 Recommendation 2 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-24-106276 Recommendation 2 remains Open – Partially Addressed. Its normalized follow-through state is Partially addressed; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Parent crosswalk: HHS-04; child record: HHS-04-R2.
Current GAO status: Open – Partially Addressed; status period: January 2026.

Response artifact: External-stakeholder after-action participation standard operating procedures. HHS developed procedures for including external stakeholders; GAO is waiting for evidence from an exercise or response showing the procedures in use.
Artifact availability: Described on the GAO page; no separate public SOP located.
Named milestone: None stated; milestone state: No named date.
GAO review state: GAO classifies Recommendation 2 Open – Partially Addressed.
Remaining gap: An exercise or response after-action report demonstrating relevant external-stakeholder participation.

Continuation rule: Recheck for an after-action report that demonstrates Recommendation 2 in operation. Preserve HHS-04 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves HHS-04 as the parent crosswalk while publishing HHS-04-R2 as a recommendation-specific child.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
